lifexp.config.preset.baby_mode.desc:
Start with 20.0 HP, massive buffs.
maxLevel: 200. No fog.
For those who just want to have fun.
lifexp.config.preset.core.desc:
Start with 1.0 HP (0.5 hearts), slowed movement.
maxLevel: 1000. Dynamic vignette overlay.
Oxygen bonus at start, burns less.
For true hardcore players.
lifexp.config.preset.core_no_streaks.des:
Classic hardcore experience with dynamic fog and 1 HP,
but without Kill Streak XP multipliers.
lifexp.config.preset.purist.desc:
Clean visual clarity with no fog,
no kill streak bonuses, and 100% death XP penalty.
lifexp.config.preset.real_hardcore.desc:
Start with 1.0 HP (0.5 hearts), reduced speed and attack.
maxLevel: 10000. Heavy vignette + ash particles.
Burns very long, suffocates faster.
For the truly insane.
lifexp.config.preset.vanilla_plus.desc:
Start with 6.0 HP, light buffs in late game.
maxLevel: 500. No fog.
Balanced mode for regular gameplay.
lifexp.config.presets.description:
Press a button to apply a ready-made preset.
The config will be overwritten and saved automatically.
The settings screen will reload to display the new values.

The Dynamic XP Bottle allows storing experience points safely. Hold Shift + Right Click to gradually channel XP levels from the player into the bottle (with a 10% tax). Normal Right Click instantly absorbs all stored XP points back with no loss, returning an empty glass bottle.
jei.life_xp_challenge.life_bottle.info: The Life Bottle saves your entire inventory (41 slots, including armor and offhand) upon death, even from falling into the End Void. It has 3 points of durability (3 uses). After respawning, Shift + Right Click with the bottle in hand to restore all saved equipment directly into their original inventory slots.
jei.life_xp_challenge.shield_core.info:
The Shield Core is brewed in a brewing stand with an Awkward Potion to create the Potion of XP Shield, which absorbs incoming damage using player experience.

Protection Tiers:
• Level I (3:00): 25% damage absorption
• Extended I (+ Redstone, 8:00): 25% absorption
• Level II (+ Glowstone, 1:30): 50% absorption
• Level III (+ Nether Star, 1:00): 75% absorption

Modifiers:
• Gunpowder: Splash Potions
• Dragon's Breath: Lingering Potions
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.life_xp_c: A hardcore mod that links player attributes to their XP level. Collect XP to become stronger, but beware of death!
